notes.title: Update with SteamDeck and Controller Support
notes.notes:
Update .05

Steamdeck Support Added
Pausemenu wont move while moving the Cursor anymore
Inverted Mouse Option added
several small fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.notes:
Hotfix
- Mouse/Cameralag removed as default. Via InGame Option it is possible to set it back on via Headbobbing(Lag Setting)

_ Red Line in the begin wont move at the begin of loading the Map anymore.

- some smaller fixes and regular maintenance

notes.title: HARDCORE UPDATE
notes.notes:

-Minor Fixes

notes.title: PATCH AND LEADERBOARDS ADDED
notes.notes:
-Leaderboards
 are now in the Game. It counts in Seconds for each full Game completion ( finishing the last walk 13)
